findings.title: Two digit systems on one screen
findings.message: "4 طلبات" uses a different digit system from the rest of the screen.
findings.fix: Pick one digit system for the product and format every number with it.

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: Arabic falls back from Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".

findings.title: Arabic set too small
findings.message: "تابع حالة الطلبات، وتاريخ الشراء، وإجمال…" is 13px.
findings.fix: Keep Arabic UI text at 14px or more, and body text at 16px.
findings.snippet: تابع حالة الطلبات، وتاريخ الشراء، وإجمالي المبلغ بسهولة.
